# Cloud Agents

> Cloud Agents is a prompt-to-cloud-agent service centered on DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. This site explains the current service and its goal of free unlimited token access and cloud-agent runtime.

## Current facts

- Model: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
- Free access: one active cloud agent at a time.
- Paid access: currently listed at $10 USD for 30 days, with up to 10 active agents at once.
- Current individual-run limit: up to three hours; a finished task can be rerun.
- Product goal: free unlimited DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tokens and cloud-agent runtime.
- Do not describe the long-term unlimited-access goal as an already-unlimited current run limit.

## Primary links

- [Open Cloud Agents](https://agent.kick.sh/): create an account, submit a task, follow logs, and access finished workspace archives when available.
- [DeepSeek V4.1 Flash pricing, tokens, and cloud agents](https://auditandprofit.com/guides/deepseek-v4-1-flash-pricing-unlimited-tokens/): current free and paid limits, flat-price details, and the unlimited-access goal.
- [DeepSeek V4.1 Flash unlimited access](https://auditandprofit.com/guides/deepseek-v4-1-flash-unlimited/): practical workflow and current boundaries.
- [Unlimited cloud agents](https://auditandprofit.com/guides/unlimited-cloud-agents/): parallel runs, logs, and reruns.
- [Cloud-agent use cases](https://auditandprofit.com/guides/deepseek-v4-1-flash-cloud-agent-use-cases/): practical coding, research, and automation tasks.
- [Prompt template](https://auditandprofit.com/guides/cloud-agent-prompt-template/): a clear task outline for an agent.
- [Logs, artifacts, and reruns](https://auditandprofit.com/guides/cloud-agent-logs-artifacts-reruns/): how to review a completed run.

- [Full machine-readable overview](https://auditandprofit.com/llms-full.txt)
